caption: The drawing contains two colored illustrations of the same carved figure shown from different perspectives: one in front view on the left side and one in rear view on the right side. The figure, which appears to be a statue, is depicted in brown tones with shading to indicate volume and contours. The figure wears a feathered headdress colored in red and brown with yellow highlights, draped hair, necklace or chest ornament, and pants with a yellow stripe running down the side. The right hand of the statue touches the forehead in a salute gesture, while the left arm rests at the side in the front view and akimbo in the back view. The figure stands with slightly bent knees and feet placed apart. The drawing is set against a plain, light beige background. Faint cross marks appear in each corner of the image, likely as alignment or registration marks.
title: Indian Chief Coin Bank
